#SBATCH --job-name=623-projected
#SBATCH --partition=cpu
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=12G
#SBATCH --time=00:10:00

set -eu
arm=${1:?arm required}
step=10
chunks=2
electrons=8
case "$arm" in
  pilot) ;;
  main) chunks=8; electrons=16 ;;
  halfstep) chunks=8; electrons=16; step=5 ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
cd /home/user/pyrite-issue623

test ! -e "$study_dir/result.json"
